plan.structural_result: Coherent; no confirmed semantic decomposition or coverage defect.
plan.rationale: Explicit 1–2 assessment is warranted. Retain one milestone: this is a narrow existing utility extension, not independent new subsystems. Four internal tasks reach real text/JSON usefulness at T-019, then complete user explanation and independently portable source delivery before the consolidated milestone exit. Parser complexity and extensive failure/option matrices remain within a single CLI contract increment. Docs and extraction establish different evidence, but can coherently form this milestone's complete usable outcome; they need not be padded into separate milestones. Early examples and demonstrations prevent usefulness waiting for final feature review.
plan.coverage: F-001 validation/pre-acquisition/huge decimals routes through T-019; F-002 shared selection through T-018 with full-decode/once-only BOM integration T-019; F-003 compatibility through T-019/T-021/T-022; F-004 and R-011–R-013 objective semantic/process/docs/extraction checks at delivery and both reviews. Retained R-001–R-009 regressions and deferred R-010 acquisition are explicit.
plan.placement: Main core has _logical_lines/_normalize_text/_count_normalized seams; layout permits C-010 co-location. Existing I/O opens binary input and completely decodes, but exposes count_file rather than a separate acquisition return seam; T-019 explicitly allows cooperating I/O refactor while retaining public API. No missing design/layout proposal is demonstrated.

tasks.structural_result: Coherent executable draft against proposed strategy; blocked for dependent use by stale durable QC and missing exact-draft acceptance.
tasks.rationale: Four tasks are not proof of quality by count. Actual responsibilities are distinct and bounded: pure traversal selection, one real parser/controller/acquisition integration, public documentation, isolated extracted verification. Tests and relevant minimal docs remain inside implementing owners; independent extraction is product acceptance rather than report-only padding. T-019's multiple cooperating modules serve one invocation contract, not a hidden whole subsystem. All active task IDs are unique and singly owned, unchecked, and dependencies are acyclic: T-018→T-019→T-021→T-022→T-020→T-024. Stable IDs justify placing T-020 after T-022 instead of renumbering. Each delivery ends with dedicated review; final feature review waits for delivery closure and excludes itself.
tasks.reviews: T-020 requires complete code review, checks, repair, useful demonstration, findings/TODO provenance and milestone report after all four deliverables. T-024 checks cross-boundary extent and final reports, carries TODOs, preserves pending main Phase 2 obligations. Neither is redundant merely because the feature has one delivery milestone: integration and extent/future-main ownership are distinct review scopes.
